# Pearltrees

> Pearltrees is an AI-powered knowledge organization and collaborative platform that enables users to curate, organize, and share digital collections with integrated generative AI capabilities.

Pearltrees combines cloud-based technology with generative AI features like Spirit 1.0 to help individuals and educational institutions organize information, collaborate on projects, and create curated knowledge collections. The platform serves both general users and schools with specialized education tools.

## Key Topics

- Generative AI integration
- Knowledge organization
- Collaborative platform
- Cloud technologies
- Pearltrees Education
- AI-powered features
